name: Portals
title: useportals.dev
shortDescription: Portals is a knowledge management tool designed to help users process and organize information from various sources. It allows users to capture data, instruct AI in plain language, and search across a unified knowledge base. Ideal for professionals overwhelmed by data, Portals can transcribe meetings, parse documents, and integrate with other apps to maintain a single source of truth. Example use case: A project manager uses Portals to manage meeting notes and track project tasks.
pros: Advanced AI integration for data handling
Customizable data objects for flexible use cases
Comprehensive search across multiple data types
cons: Potentially steep learning curve for new users
Pricing might not be competitive for all users
